name: Tessera Industries Reality Anchor Projector RAP-1
product_name: Tessera Industries Reality Anchor Projector RAP-1
description: A device that disrupts holographic projections, augmented reality overlays, and adaptive camouflage systems within a 15-meter radius by emitting a structured light pattern that interferes with the coherent light used by these systems. The RAP-1 essentially forces the visual environment to be real — holograms flicker and collapse, AR overlays glitch and disappear, and active camouflage systems display artifacts that reveal the concealed object. Tessera developed it as a countermeasure to their own holographic and metamaterial products, recognizing that a tool to defeat illusions has as much market value as the illusions themselves.

specifications.info: AR overlays; active camouflage; AR glitches; camo shows artifacts
specifications.limitations: Does not affect passive materials or metamaterial surfaces

story_hooks: A RAP-1 activated at a social event revealed that three of the guests were holographic projections — no one knew they were not physically present, and the question of who sent the holograms and why they needed to appear present is urgent.

A modified RAP-1 has been developed that forces ROCL augmented reality overlays to display the raw, unmodified physical environment — users describe the experience as seeing their world stripped naked, and some find the real version deeply disturbing.
related_entities: Axiom Systems Reality Overlay Consensus Layer

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, angular wand resembling a hybrid between a tactical flashlight and a medical diagnostic probe. The barrel tapers from a wider grip section to a narrower emission head. The front emitter face features a complex array of micro-optics arranged in a geometric lattice pattern. Overall aesthetic is clinical and purposeful, with an almost surgical precision to its construction.
physical_description.dimensions: 28 cm length, 4.5 cm grip diameter, emitter head 3 cm diameter. Handheld wand category, extends from fingertips to mid-forearm when gripped.
physical_description.weight_description: 0.5 kg — comfortably handheld for extended periods, lightweight enough to pocket or attach to gear harness, but substantial enough to feel engineered rather than toy-like.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade aluminum frame with reinforced polymer grip section; emission head is precision glass/synthetic crystal matrix.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal gray powder-coat on barrel with anodized aluminum accents. Grip features knurled texturing. Emitter face has subtle iridescent coating that shifts between blue-violet in certain angles — visible indication of optical complexity beneath.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray body with slate blue grip accent stripe. Emitter face faintly opalescent. Three indicator LEDs (red/amber/green) embedded near the activation switch.
physical_description.interface_elements: Recessed push-button activation switch on grip (requires deliberate pressure). Digital readout display (small 2x1 cm monochrome LCD) showing battery percentage and current output intensity. Micro-USB charging port with protective cap. Three-position intensity dial (low/medium/high) with tactile detents.
distinctive_features: Emitter head features visible geometric lattice of micro-optics that creates faint light-diffraction patterns even when powered down
Faint violet glow visible from the emitter face when active — structured light pattern visible as subtle shimmer
Heat-dissipation ribbing along barrel gives it a slightly biomechanical appearance
Tessera Industries branded holographic nameplate (fitting for a device that defeats holograms) on barrel near grip
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Tessera Industries logo (geometric T within a circle) on barrel. 'RAP-1' designation below logo. Vasquez Biocompatible Materials certification mark near charging port. Regulatory stamps for GLMZ electromagnetic compliance. Serial number etched on grip.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually seen mounted on a tactical rail or held at ready during counter-surveillance operations. Battery indicator typically shows 60-80% charge from regular use. May show minor scorching or discoloration around emitter face from extended high-intensity operation.
